chain.label: Flight in IMC with rain and low ceilings
chain.trigger: Instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) prevailed at the time of the accident... in rain

chain.label: Turbulence in the clouds along the route
chain.trigger: the presence of turbulence would have made it more difficult to control the airplane with failed instrumentation

chain.label: Limited partial-panel experience and undetermined instrument currency
chain.trigger: flights... that contained the remark 'partial panel flight' totaled to about 12.3 hours, none of which were in a Cessna 335

chain.label: Primary (left-side) attitude indicator failed in flight
chain.trigger: we got a primary attitude indicator that's not uh reading properly having to try and fly off of copilot

chain.label: Pilot became spatially disoriented from head movements cross-checking the remote right-side attitude indicator
chain.trigger: using the right-side attitude indicator would have resulted in the pilot making frequent, rapid head movements... The pilot's head movements most likely caused him to experience spatial disorientation.

caused_by.evidence: the right-side attitude indicator was not large and would have been several feet to the right of the pilot
occurred at night in dark lighting conditions
Under IFR conditions, an aircraft's attitude can only be determined accurately by observing and interpreting the flight instruments
the rain conditions... would have increased the noise level in the cockpit, and the presence of turbulence... would likely have exacerbated the pilot's spatial disorientation
Practice and experience in instrument flying are necessary to help pilots ignore or overcome false sensations.

chain.label: Loss of control during climbing right turn at 7,700 feet
chain.trigger: the pilot lost control of the airplane at 7,700 feet as he was making a climbing right turn

caused_by.evidence: The disoriented pilot may maneuver the aircraft into a dangerous attitude in an attempt to correct the aircraft's perceived attitude.

chain.label: Steep uncontrolled descent at about 26,000 fpm
chain.trigger: the calculated descent rate was about 26,000 fpm, the calculated airspeed was greater than 300 knots, and the airplane was at approximately a 60 degree nose-down attitude

caused_by.evidence: After reaching 7,700 feet... the airplane began a steep descent.

chain.label: Impact with trees and rocky terrain
chain.trigger: the airplane remained intact and was in an upright attitude when it contacted trees at a velocity of over 300 knots and then impacted rocky terrain

caused_by.evidence: The initial terrain impact occurred along the slope of a heavily wooded hillside.

chain.label: Pilot and two passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and two passengers were killed, and the airplane was destroyed.
